pips suicide prevention ireland weekend crisis hopeline, a regional overnight telephone service available friday and sunday nights, to anyone across northern ireland experiencing emotional distress, suicidal thoughts, or a mental health crisis. the operational hours for the weekend crisis hopeline are as follows. friday: 9pm - 10am saturday sunday: 9pm - 9am monday 028 $080 5850 | freephone 0800 088 6042 we know that crisis doesn't wait for working hours. the weekend crisis hopeline provides a confidential, non-judgemental space to talk with a trained crisis practitloner when someone is in distress, needs support or simply wants someone to talk to during a difficult time outside of usual working hours. there is no referral process for the hopeline, and individuals can contact us directly whenever they feel in need of support. for more information, please feel free to refer to our website where the information on the weekend crisis hopeline is posted: weekend crisis hopeline - pips suicide prevention ireland if someone is in immediate danger or there is an emergency, call 999 immediately or attend your nearest accident & emergency department, eucharistic healing & blessing service in st matthews church on thursday 22™ october at 7pm women’s discernment night are you a young women discerning god's call? thursday 22°4 october at 7pm in st colmcille’s church ballyhackamore. see church notice board for further details
